I’m still stuck on having to buy $20,000 worth of your own tools. I’d have every single piece tied to my body. ​​⁠I worked as a vet tech for years and we had everything provided for us, even our doctors. If I wanted to use one of the schools crappy cellos, I could. Rosin is available for use, guitar picks, pencils. I guess those are only two jobs, but I’m just blown away by industries that require that much.
